prose.subject: Invoice INV-50024 - Marlow Freight Services
prose.body:
Dear Eastgate Clinics Accounting Team,

Please find attached our monthly invoice INV-50024 for freight services rendered during the current billing cycle. The total amount due is 8796.62 USDC.

Line Items:
1. Standard Cargo Transport (Zone 4): 4200.00 USDC
2. Priority Handling Fees: 1150.50 USDC
3. Fuel Surcharge (Monthly Adjustment): 890.12 USDC
4. Warehouse Storage (15 days): 2556.00 USDC

Payment Terms: Net 30 days.

Please remit payment to our designated account: marlowfreight31.testnet

This account remains our standard destination for all settlements. No changes have been made to our banking details. If you have any questions regarding the line items or the service period, please contact our billing department directly.

Thank you for your continued partnership with Marlow Freight.

Best regards,

Julian Vane
Accounts Receivable Manager
Marlow Freight
